investigations.Subject: Nature of gravity
investigations.Research Question: Is gravity fundamentally force, geometry, emergent phenomenon, quantum interaction, or something deeper?

investigations.Subject: Newtonian gravity
investigations.Research Question: Define exact validity range, inverse-square behavior, weak-field approximation, and deviations.

investigations.Subject: General Relativity
investigations.Research Question: Determine what GR permits for attraction, repulsion, exotic stress-energy, and engineered spacetime.

investigations.Subject: Equivalence principle
investigations.Research Question: Test whether gravitational and inertial mass are equivalent and identify constrained violations.

investigations.Subject: Action at a distance vs field mediation
investigations.Research Question: Trace the transition from Newtonian action-at-distance to fields, geometry, and quantum mediation.

investigations.Subject: Spacetime curvature
investigations.Research Question: Determine whether curvature can be locally engineered rather than merely sourced by ordinary mass-energy.

investigations.Subject: Stress-energy tensor engineering
investigations.Research Question: Identify components of T_mu_nu capable of producing repulsive geodesic behavior.

investigations.Subject: Gravity of energy, pressure and radiation
investigations.Research Question: Quantify gravity sourced by non-rest-mass energy, pressure, and radiation.

investigations.Subject: Negative mass
investigations.Research Question: Assess consistency and distinguish inertial, passive, and active gravitational mass.

investigations.Subject: Negative energy density
investigations.Research Question: Assess QFT negative energy, Casimir configurations, quantum inequalities, and achievable magnitude.

investigations.Subject: Negative pressure
investigations.Research Question: Assess gravitational roles of negative pressure, vacuum energy, and inflation-like stress.

investigations.Subject: Dark energy
investigations.Research Question: Determine the evidence for cosmic acceleration and whether any local analogue is physically meaningful.

investigations.Subject: Cosmological constant
investigations.Research Question: Relate vacuum energy to repulsive cosmological gravity and local engineering constraints.

investigations.Subject: Quantum gravity
investigations.Research Question: Identify experimentally distinguishable quantum-gravity signatures.

investigations.Subject: Graviton hypothesis
investigations.Research Question: Assess whether a quantum-field description of gravity offers measurable or controllable mechanisms.

investigations.Subject: Quantum superposition of mass
investigations.Research Question: Determine achievable source mass, separation, coherence time, and environmental limits.

investigations.Subject: Gravity sourced by superposition
investigations.Research Question: Determine predicted fields/interactions generated by a spatially superposed source mass.

investigations.Subject: Quantum interference of gravitational paths
investigations.Research Question: Reproduce how interference generates the predicted anomalous or repulsive conditional result.

investigations.Subject: Conditional gravitational repulsion
investigations.Research Question: Determine exactly where and why the effective force changes sign.

investigations.Subject: Post-selection
investigations.Research Question: Determine whether the repulsive result exists physically or only after conditional measurement selection.

investigations.Subject: Weak values / anomalous expectation values
investigations.Research Question: Test whether the repulsion is best classified as a weak-value or anomalous conditional expectation effect.

investigations.Subject: Unconditional repulsive gravity
investigations.Research Question: Determine whether positive mean repulsive force can arise without conditioning.

investigations.Subject: Momentum conservation
investigations.Research Question: Trace complete-system momentum in every claimed propulsion or gravity-control effect.

investigations.Subject: Energy conservation
investigations.Research Question: Perform complete-system energy accounting for all candidate mechanisms.

investigations.Subject: Quantum decoherence
investigations.Research Question: Establish coherence limits for massive superpositions and gravity-mediated experiments.

investigations.Subject: Quantum-to-classical transition
investigations.Research Question: Determine where environmental or gravity-linked decoherence dominates.

investigations.Subject: Gravity-mediated entanglement
investigations.Research Question: Assess BMV-type proposals, assumptions, observables, and experimental readiness.

investigations.Subject: Classical-channel gravity models
investigations.Research Question: Identify classical or hybrid models capable of reproducing candidate quantum-gravity signatures.

investigations.Subject: Semiclassical gravity
investigations.Research Question: Evaluate semiclassical Einstein equations for quantum source states and competing predictions.

investigations.Subject: Quantum reference frames
investigations.Research Question: Assess frame dependence of superposition, entanglement, and equivalence-principle statements.
